scripts.compile: cd contracts && export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && forge build
scripts.test: cd contracts && export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && forge test -vv
scripts.coverage: cd contracts && export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && forge coverage --report summary
scripts.format: cd contracts && export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && forge fmt
scripts.test:all: cd contracts && export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && forge test -vv && cd ../frontend && npm test
